instruction:
Use the ANSYS Mechanical APDL GUI to complete the following analysis:

Physical problem: ideal elastic-plastic round bar under displacement-controlled uniaxial tension, validating the yield plateau.

Model parameters:
- Cylinder diameter 10 mm, length 50 mm
- Material: ideal elastic-plastic steel, E = 210000 MPa, yield strength 250 MPa, tangent modulus 0
- Element: SOLID185
- Mesh: global element size 3 mm

Boundary conditions and load:
- One end face: fully constrained
- Other end face: displacement-controlled, UY = 2 mm (tension direction)

Analysis type: nonlinear static analysis, large deflection enabled, automatic time stepping, 50-100 substeps

Save requirements:
- Database file: apdl_plastic.db
- Result file (.rst) must exist in the working directory
